interpretation: Coverage records what the repository has durably staged and validated. Program contracts, issue counts, declared denominators, frontier questions, and source potential are not observed research findings and do not count as public evidentiary progress.

consumption.what_this_is: A reproducible accounting of staged case contracts, candidate questions, executable validation, and current research gaps.
consumption.what_this_is_not: A count of verified claims, completed source searches, customers, contracts, deployments, affected people, wrongdoing, scientific failures, or complete market coverage.
consumption.copy_ready_caveat: These counts describe staged research architecture, not completed research or verified facts. Expected values describe declared work or denominators; observed values count only durable repository objects at the stated capture date. Zero verified receipts, promoted claims, or graph effects must not be read as evidence that no relevant facts exist.
